itemUsage.en: Pedro, a name so common it is always overlooked.
itemUsage.zh: 佩德洛，一个因过于常见而总是被忽略的名字。

itemDesc.en: He tries his best to understand those who go to their deaths, yet never expects anyone to understand him.
itemDesc.zh: 他努力地想要理解赴死的人们，却不曾期待过有人能理解自己。

description.en: Increases the ATK of the next attack to <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>, attacks 2 targets simultaneously, and applies a <$ba.triggereffect>Trigger-type Effect</> to them (does not stack; prioritizes targets without the effect): When taking Arts damage, takes additional Arts damage equal to <@ba.vup>{debuff_atk_scale:0%}</> of Pedro's ATK
description.zh: 下次攻击的攻击力提升至<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>，同时攻击2个目标并对目标施加<$ba.triggereffect>触发型效果</>（不叠加，优先选择未持有该效果的目标）：受到法术伤害时，额外受到相当于佩德洛<@ba.vup>{debuff_atk_scale:0%}</>攻击力的法术伤害

description.en: Applies a <$ba.triggereffect>Trigger-type Effect</> to <@ba.vup>{max_target}</> Operators in range (does not stack; prioritizes targets without the effect): When HP falls below <@ba.vup>{hp_ratio:0%}</>, immediately restores HP equal to <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of Pedro's ATK and reduces the chance of being targeted by attacks for <@ba.vup>{duration}</> seconds\n<@ba.rem>Can store 2 charges</>
description.zh: 对范围内的<@ba.vup>{max_target}</>名干员施加<$ba.triggereffect>触发型效果</>（不叠加，优先选择未持有该效果的目标）：生命值低于<@ba.vup>{hp_ratio:0%}</>时，立刻治疗相当于佩德洛<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>攻击力的生命值且在<@ba.vup>{duration}</>秒内不容易受到攻击\n<@ba.rem>可充能2次</>
